name: Lille Arclight
original_name: リル アークライト
source:
The protagonist. An apprentice adventurer who is currently training under the wing of her master Tanya. 

Brimming with talent in both the martial and magic arts, her potential is such that even the veteran adventurer Tanya rates her as the "Once in a century Prodigy". 

Despite being slightly cowardly and with no appreciation of her talents, Lille continues to dream of becoming a fully-fledged adventurer one day.

[Spoiler] The offspring of Will Arclight, a warrior father, and a sorceress mother, Lyiene, Lille has inherited both of the talents of her parents. Her father has the moniker of "Dragon Slayer" while her mother's bloodline means she's distantly related to the "Witches" in the story.

She is initially very reluctant to venture out of Carne village on her own when Tanya tells her to go out and gain battlefield experience, but she eventually develops and acquires the courage to become independent of Tanya and the resolve to save the village from its plight. [/Spoiler]
